subject: Telemetry connector governance & onboarding plan — Datadog / Grafana
messages:
From: Aaron Li <aaron@datadoghq.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partnership: certifying Datadog connector for Redwood Dedicated

Hi Hannah —

Great to connect at KubeCon. Datadog is keen to certify a streamlined connector for Redwood Dedicated + Private customers (Datadog Managed Pipelines + OTLP ingestion). We think joint certification will shorten time-to-value for mutual customers and unlock co-marketing.

High-level ask from our side:
- Technical sync to validate OTLP traces/metrics mapping and metrics naming conventions
- Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence exchange
- Test environment credentials (staging API key / ingest endpoint)
- Draft partner MSA for legal alignment

Proposed next steps: 30–45 min tech call this week, followed by a short scoping SOW. I can bring our integrations PM and a solution architect.

Attachments: Redwood_DD_Telemetry_Spec-v1.pdf (connector mapping example)

Thanks —
Aaron Li
Partnerships, Datadog
aaron@datadoghq.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Li <aaron@datadoghq.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: certifying Datadog connector for Redwood Dedicated

Thanks Aaron — this sounds promising. We have a few guardrails to validate up front given Dedicated / Private deployments:

1) Security/compliance: we need SOC2 artifacts and a short list of required network/IP allowlists for private deployments.
2) Telemetry formats: we prefer OTLP over agent-based pulls; we’ll confirm whether we need to proxy through our control plane or allow direct ingestion from customer VPCs.
3) Customer data flow: clarify where traces/metrics persist and any retention differences between hosted and partner-managed ingestion.

Jonas — can you own the technical sync? Camila — can you scope a short POC in a Dedicated sandbox? Vanessa — I’ll loop you for GTM/partner collaterals after the tech validation.

Availability: Wed 11 Aug 11:00–12:00 PT or Thu 12 Aug 09:00–10:00 PT. Aaron, which works for your team?

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.ai

From: Aaron Li <aaron@datadoghq.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Priya Menon <priya@grafana.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: certifying Datadog connector for Redwood Dedicated

Thanks — Wed 11 Aug 11:00 PT is perfect for us. I’ll have our integrations PM (Priya) and solutions architect (Samir) on the call.

Quick answers to your bullets:
- SOC2: I’ll attach our SOC2 summary to the calendar invite and follow up with a link to our security portal.
- OTLP: full support for OTLP; we can accept direct push ingestion to a Datadog-managed endpoint or provide guidance for sidecar agent deployment inside customer VPCs.
- Retention: standard Datadog retention applies; for certified partners we can document expected retention windows and archival options.

I’ve attached a starter partner MSA (partner_msa_draft.docx) and the connector mapping you’ll find helpful.

See you Wed.

Aaron

Attachments: partner_msa_draft.docx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Li <aaron@datadoghq.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 12:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: certifying Datadog connector for Redwood Dedicated

Aaron / Hannah — thanks. Quick pre-call notes from the infra/serving side:

- Ownership: Jonas Weber (serving runtime) will be the primary technical owner for the connector validation; Camila will run the POC on Dedicated. Marissa will validate observability SLIs are surfaced in our console.
- Environments: we can provision a Dedicated sandbox (poe-redwood-dedicated-staging) with a restricted test tenant. Please provide an ingest endpoint and ephemeral API key. If Datadog requires egress rules, include the IP ranges.
- Telemetry mapping: we prefer semantic conventions based on OpenTelemetry; link to internal mapping: https://redwood-internal/repo/telemetry/otel-mapping.md
- Metrics naming: ask Datadog for recommended metric names for LLM-specific signals (token_latency_ms, batch_size, kv_cache_hit_rate).

I’ll bring a minimal check-run plan to the call: connectivity -> sample traces -> metrics correctness -> dashboard sanity -> SLO smoke test.

Jonas
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Aaron Li <aaron@datadoghq.com>, Priya Menon <priya@grafana.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: certifying Datadog connector for Redwood Dedicated

Quick follow-up after the call — thanks everyone for the sync. A few technical clarifications we need before the POC:

1) Span attributes: will Datadog preserve custom span attributes from our runtime (e.g., model_id, quantization_level) without truncation?
2) Trace sampling: we typically do adaptive sampling for heavy production workloads; does the Datadog ingestion pipeline support sampled spans with deterministic sampling keys?
3) Grafana: Priya, would Grafana be part of the certified UX flow (dashboards exported to Grafana Cloud) or would we keep dashboards inside Datadog and provide Grafana exporters?

Action items we’ll take: provision Dedicated sandbox and instrument a small model endpoint to emit OTLP traces + metrics. I’ll attach the ops checklist once complete.

Attachments: ops_connectivity_checklist.xlsx

-Camila
Platform Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aaron Li <aaron@datadoghq.com>, Priya Menon <priya@grafana.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Summary & next steps: Datadog / Grafana telemetry connector path to certification

Folks — thanks for the productive week. Finalizing notes and owners here so we’re aligned: 

1) Security & legal: Hannah to coordinate SOC2 evidence exchange and review partner_msa_draft.docx with legal. Aaron to send the DocuSign envelope for signature (linked).
2) Tech POC: Jonas (owner) + Camila (POC lead) — provision Dedicated sandbox and exchange ephemeral keys. Datadog to provide a staging ingest endpoint and IP allowlist.
3) Telemetry mapping: Camila & Jonas to validate OTLP mapping; Priya to confirm Grafana export options. Use the internal mapping doc (link above) as canonical.
4) QA & GTM: Marissa to validate dashboards/SLOs in Redwood Console; Vanessa to scope co-branded collateral and a short launch plan once certification is complete.

Milestones:
- Week 1: SOC2 artifacts + partner MSA signed
- Week 2: POC completed (sample traces & metrics validated)
- Week 3: Docs + co-marketing brief ready

Please confirm these owners or flag any blockers by EOD Monday. I’ll create a short mutual action plan doc and share a checkbox SOW draft.

Thanks,
Hannah
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
